details: US-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs have experienced a record nine consecutive days of net outflows, totaling $2.84 billion. BlackRock's IBIT accounted for over $2 billion of these withdrawals. This streak marks the longest since the ETFs launched in January 2024, indicating sustained institutional selling pressure. Ethereum ETFs also saw 13 consecutive days of outflows.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Record Nine-Day Outflow Streak

details: The FBI, in collaboration with international partners, has seized over $8 billion in cryptocurrency as part of "Operation Blackout," a crackdown on an international online investment fraud organization. The operation led to the arrest of approximately 300 suspects and freed around 2,000 victims subjected to forced labor and kidnapping. This marks the largest crypto forfeiture in U.S. history.
title: FBI Seizes $8 Billion in Crypto in Global Fraud Crackdown

details: BNB, the native token of the Binance ecosystem, has seen a notable increase, surpassing 680 USDT. The price reached 681.7 USDT, marking a 24-hour rise of 7.9%. This surge indicates positive momentum for the exchange's token.
title: BNB Surges Past $680 Mark

details: A bipartisan group of U.S. lawmakers has introduced the Digital Asset Protection, Accountability, Regulation, Innovation, Taxation, and Yields (PARITY) Act. This legislation aims to establish a clear tax framework for digital assets, close wealth gaps, and provide clarity for consumers and investors.
title: US Lawmakers Introduce Bipartisan PARITY Act for Digital Asset Tax Rules

details: An early Ethereum participant has sold approximately $136 million worth of ETH and wrapped staked ETH (wstETH) over the past week. The sale included 55,000 ETH at an average price of $2,041 and 9,442 wstETH, signaling a significant reduction in exposure by a long-term holder.
title: Early Ethereum Investor Offloads $136 Million in ETH and wstETH

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has approved KalshiEX's BTCPERP contract, making Kalshi the first U.S. regulated exchange to offer Bitcoin perpetual futures. This approval opens a new regulated market for perpetual futures to U.S. investors, a market that has seen significant offshore volume.
title: CFTC Approves Kalshi for First US Regulated Bitcoin Perpetual Futures

details: Stellar's native token XLM surged by over 40% after the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) announced plans to integrate its tokenized asset platform with the Stellar network by the first half of 2027. This move is a significant institutional endorsement for Stellar in the real-world asset (RWA) tokenization space.
title: Stellar (XLM) Surges as DTCC Selects It for Asset Tokenization

details: The cross-chain protocol Gravity Bridge, connecting Ethereum and the Cosmos ecosystem, was exploited for approximately $5.4 million. Investigators suspect a key compromise rather than a smart contract bug. The stolen assets included USDC, ETH, USDT, and PAYG, with some funds reportedly laundered through Binance and ChangeNow.
title: Gravity Bridge Suffers $5.4 Million Exploit

details: MicroStrategy has transferred 411.48 BTC, valued at roughly $30.3 million, to Coinbase Prime. This move has sparked speculation among market participants about a potential sale, especially following recent comments from MicroStrategy executives about potentially selling some Bitcoin holdings as part of their capital management strategy.
title: MicroStrategy Transfers $30 Million in Bitcoin to Coinbase Prime
